Question 2

Given that F(x,y)=⟨ye−x,−yey⟩ and f(x,y)=x, calculate ∇⋅(fF).

a
y(1−x)e−x−x(1+y)ey
b
(y−x)e−x−(x+y)ey
c
y(2−x)e−x+x(2+y)ey
d
y(y−x)e−x−x(x+y)ey
e
y(1+x)e−x+x(1−y)ey
